job.title: Data Engineer II, Sales Data Services
job.pay_full: $145,300 – $196,600 a year base salary (New York), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Sales Data Services (SDS) is a big-data engineering team in Amazon Ads' Sales Intelligence, Technology & Enablement organization. It builds Amazon-wide datasets that combine advertiser, seller and vendor KPIs, served through a data warehouse, fast APIs and agent-based tools, for sales teams across Amazon's worldwide advertising business: business processes, machine learning, account management, marketing and decision systems.
duties: Design, implement and support data warehouse and data lake infrastructure on the AWS big-data stack with Python and Redshift
Build and manage ETLs that bring data from many data lakes into a unified model for analytics and reporting
Enable technical and non-technical colleagues to self-serve their analytics, and handle ad-hoc reporting
Learn the data sources deeply and know which data answers which business problem
Prioritise many concurrent requests and collaborate across teams
Mentor other engineers and help grow the team
Work with BI engineers, data scientists, product managers and software teams to turn requirements into scalable data solutions
needs: 3+ years building and running large-scale BI data structures with ETL/ELT processes
3+ years building and running large-scale BI data structures with SQL
3+ years in this job or a related occupation
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics or a related field
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
nice: AWS services such as Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda and IAM
Non-relational data stores (object storage, document, key-value, graph, column-family)
details.benefits: Base salary $145,300 – $196,600 a year (New York). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities

yt_title: Amazon Is Hiring a Data Engineer II in New York ($145K–$197K) – Full Job Details

scenes.head: Today's job
lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.
Today, Amazon is hiring a Data Engineer Two for its Sales Data Services team in New York City.

scenes.head: About the team
lines: The team sits inside Amazon Ads. It builds Amazon-wide datasets that bring together advertiser, seller, and vendor performance numbers.

That data is served through a data warehouse, fast A P Is, and agent-based tools, and sales teams across Amazon's global advertising business use it for planning, machine learning, account management, and marketing.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Build warehouse & data lake infra on AWS
lines: You'll design, build, and support data warehouse and data lake infrastructure on A W S, using Python and Redshift.
You'll build and manage E T L pipelines that pull from many data lakes into one unified model for analytics and reporting.
You'll help colleagues, technical or not, answer their own questions with self-serve reporting, and step in for one-off requests.
And you'll mentor other engineers and help the team grow.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: Bachelor's in CS, engineering, IS, math or related
Plus: Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda
lines: The basics: three or more years of data engineering, and three years building large-scale data structures for business intelligence with E T L or E L T, and with S Q L.
Add two years with OLAP technologies, a year of data modeling, and a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, math, or a related field.
It's a plus if you know A W S services like Redshift, S three, Glue, E M R, Kinesis, and Lambda, and non-relational data stores.

scenes.head: Pay & benefits
lines: Base pay in New York is one hundred forty-five thousand three hundred to one hundred ninety-six thousand six hundred dollars a year.
The package adds sign-on payments and restricted stock units, plus health coverage, four-oh-one-k matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
